title: HEIST ATTACK
description: Get KSh 50 for signing up. Complete the steps and claim your reward.
whatYouGet: Get KSh 50 after completing the required signup and verification steps, subject to the promotion's eligibility requirements.
steps: Download the Absa app from Google Play.
Open Complete Profile and finish the required information.
Check the account for the applicable reward.
Referral participants can qualify for the stated referral reward according to the promotion terms.
importantNotes: Referral and reward eligibility may depend on the provider's current promotion terms and requirements. Complete all required steps and verify the current offer before participating.

title: LOOP KYC
description: Register on Loop with my invite code and complete your profile to get KSh 150.
whatYouGet: New users who successfully register through my invite code and complete their Loop profile receive KSh 150. Because I am the referrer, I receive KSh 200 for each successful referral. Downloading the app alone does not qualify — registration must be completed with a fully finished profile.
steps: Download the Loop app from the Google Play Store.
Only after your profile is fully completed is the registration considered successful and eligible for the KSh 150 reward.
importantNotes: ⚠️ Downloading or creating an account is not enough. Your profile must be fully completed for the registration to qualify.
